subject: SOC2 tabletop — IR drill summary & evidence snapshot
messages:
From: Samir Kaur <samir@brightretail.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: audrey.lopez@brightretail.com
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: artifacts from your June tabletop IR drill for SOC2 evidence

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for running the tabletop with our security team last month. As part of our SOC 2 evidence package we need the following items from the drill:

- The final drill playbook used by Redwood (PDF)
- A short timeline of decisions and communications during the scenario (UTC timestamps)
- Any exported inbound/outbound audit log snippets relevant to authentication and session termination for 2027-06-17 (CSV OK)
- A short post-drill summary (1 page) highlighting gaps and mitigations

Can you confirm what you can share by next week? We can treat some items as redacted/sanitized if needed (IPs, customer IDs).

Appreciate it — Samir
Samir Kaur
Sr. Security Compliance Manager
BrightRetail Inc.

From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: Samir Kaur <samir@brightretail.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 13:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: artifacts from your June tabletop IR drill for SOC2 evidence

Samir —

Thanks for the clear list. We ran an internal tabletop on 2027-06-17 that mirrored the scenario you observed; happy to share an evidence bundle. We will:

1) Produce the drill playbook (PDF) with any proprietary sections redacted.
2) Export a time-ordered timeline (UTC) of the exercise, including owner handoffs and notifications.
3) Pull the audit log snapshot for authentication/session events for the date you requested and sanitize customer identifiers.
4) Draft a concise post-drill brief with action owners and ETA for remediation items.

Ben will help with the log export; Marissa will review the redactions and legal/PR language. I can deliver a preliminary package by Monday 2027-07-05 EOD PST. Does that work?

Markus Klein
Director, Security Operations
Redwood Inference
(attachment: planned-evidence-index.txt)

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Samir Kaur <samir@brightretail.com>, markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Log export and redaction approach

Samir / Markus —

I'm working on the audit export. Notes on approach:

- We'll export session/auth events for 2027-06-17 00:00:00 — 23:59:59 UTC.
- Customer identifiers will be hashed; internal hostnames/IPs will be truncated to /24.
- We'll include an index file that maps redaction placeholders to event types (no customer PII).
- Expected file: audit-log-snapshot-20270701.csv (CSV, ~1200 rows before redaction).

If BrightRetail needs raw logs (non-redacted) we require an NDA addendum — otherwise the sanitized CSV will be used as SOC2 evidence.

Ben Carter
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
(attachment: export-script.sh)

From: Audrey Lopez <audrey.lopez@brightretail.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2027 10:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: artifacts from your June tabletop IR drill for SOC2 evidence

Hi Markus / Ben —

This plan sounds good. Two quick clarifications before you deliver:

- Timeline format: can you include both local timestamps and UTC for each event? Our SOC auditor prefers UTC but we need local offsets for context.
- Can the post-drill brief call out the two mitigation steps we discussed on the call (session timeout tightening + automated alerting for failed auth burst)? A simple table with owner and ETA is sufficient.

If you can confirm those, we'll accept sanitized artifacts. We do not need raw logs. Thanks for moving fast on this.

—Audrey
Audrey Lopez
Information Security, BrightRetail Inc.

From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: Samir Kaur <samir@brightretail.com>, Audrey Lopez <audrey.lopez@brightretail.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2027 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: artifacts from your June tabletop IR drill for SOC2 evidence

Audrey / Samir —

Attached is the preliminary evidence bundle per our commitments:

- ir-drill-playbook.pdf (redacted) — canonical playbook used in the tabletop
- audit-log-snapshot-20270701.csv (sanitized CSV) — time-ordered authentication/session events with UTC and local offset columns
- postmortem-brief-20270705.pdf — 1-page summary with identified gaps and mitigation table (owners + ETAs)
- planned-evidence-index.txt — mapping of redaction placeholders to event types

High level summary: during the drill we observed a gap in automated escalation for failed auth spikes and a loose session timeout policy on a legacy auth path. Action items:

- Ben to deploy alerting rule for failed auth burst threshold (ETA: 2027-07-12)
- Marissa to publish updated session timeout policy and rollout plan (ETA: 2027-07-19)

If you want, we can schedule a 30-minute walkthrough this week to go through the files and redaction approach. Otherwise, confirm receipt and we'll consider this delivered for SOC2 evidence intake.

Thanks — Markus
Director, Security Operations
Redwood Inference
(attachments: ir-drill-playbook.pdf, audit-log-snapshot-20270701.csv, postmortem-brief-20270705.pdf)
